title: On the Need and Applicability of Causality for Fairness: A Unified Framework for AI Auditing and Legal Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical evaluation using directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to map out confounders (e.g., socio-economic status), mediators, and colliders in a hypothetical automated job hiring scenario.

Demonstrating causal mediation analysis and Simpson's paradox using historical observational data from the 1973 Berkeley graduate admissions study, alongside a review of landmark legal cases (e.g., Pickett, Loomis).
Analyzing proxy discrimination and counterfactual reasoning (the 'but-for' test) through the review of landmark legal cases involving algorithmic decision-making (e.g., Cook v. HSBC, Ewert).
